ex.s: Without the education I was throwing away, I’d turn to theft and go to prison.
ex.t: 没有我正在抛弃的教育，我会走上偷窃的道路，然后进监狱。

ex.s: Michael Kelsey Paris, vice president of the Oklahoma Cattlemen's Association, said a robot could be extremely useful given rising concerns about cattle theft.
ex.t: 牛通常被养在偏远地区，其价值不断上升，使其成为诱人的目标。

ex.s: Robbie Pruitt admitted that he got 16   when he discovered the theft of his mountain bike last September.
ex.t: 罗比·普鲁特承认去年9月发现他的山地自行车被偷时他很   16   愤怒。

Some people have experienced damage to their properties whilst renting out their homes and others have found themselves victims of theft or attack while sharing rides.
ex.t: 有些人在出租房屋时财产遭到损坏，还有些人在拼车时成了盗窃或袭击的受害者。

ex.s: Identity theft is a common and serious problem.
ex.t: 身份盗窃是一个常见且严重的问题。

ex.s: However, problems can also develop, like the theft of bikes and parking issues.Fortunately,people are trying different ways of solving those problems.
ex.t: 然而，也可能出现问题，比如自行车被盗和停车问题。幸运的是，人们正在尝试不同的方法解决这些问题。

ex.s: There were break-ins and car thefts and it just got worse every month.
ex.t: 入室盗窃和汽车失窃频发，而且一个月比一个月严重。

ex.s: Although a number of tombs have survived with little damage, all have suffered at least some harm from centuries of rain, war, fire and theft.
ex.t: 尽管一些陵墓几乎没有受损地保存下来，但所有陵墓都至少遭受了数百年风雨、战争、火灾和盗窃的某种损害。
